lag_convention: lag = positions-clock time minus steps-clock time of the same physical event (ms or s as labelled)
H0: positions.ms and steps.ms share the signalStart clock (expected lag ~0)
H1: positions.ms is relative to testStart, steps.ms to signalStart (expected lag ~ -testStart)

xcorr_settings.signals: GPS speed (valid >=0, only within 3 s of a real sample, no filling elsewhere) vs steps/s from cumulative steps (running max, linear between samples)

decision.convention: H0: treat positions.ms and steps.ms as the same signalStart clock; apply NO per-track or global lag shift; do not re-base positions by testStart.
decision.confidence: moderate (clock identity supported; sub-window offsets of a few seconds cannot be excluded)
evidence_for: Last stamps of the two streams agree: see end_of_recording_pos_last_minus_steps_last_ms (median ~0.2 s, IQR about -0.7..+1.5 s); both end near testEnd (not testEnd-testStart).
In the tracks with testStart>5 s (where H0 and H1 differ by >5 s) the end-of-recording residual is smaller under H0 in most tracks: see end_of_recording_tracks_testStart_gt_5s.
steps.ms - endDate is a small positive offset (iOS pedometer reporting delay), not a testStart-sized shift; metadata fs_gnss/fs_steps equal observed row counts / duration.
last steps value equals metadata totSteps in all but one track (+1).
evidence_inconclusive_or_against_precisi: Speed vs step-rate cross-correlation has low power (steady-pace walking); the lag distribution is wide with weak peaks in most tracks, with no consistent lag across tracks. Only the high-peak band (>=0.7) is informative, and its lag is centred within a few seconds of 0 with mixed sign (see xcorr_lag_by_peak_band).
Cumulative-distance vs cumulative-steps timing is biased by pre-walk GPS jitter and late first step rows and cannot separate H0/H1 (cum_rms_H0 ~ cum_rms_H1).

positions.csv contains rows with ms<0 (pre-start stamps) in most tracks; README says 'ms from signalStart' and also 'zero corresponds to testStart' (contradiction), so documentation alone is ambiguous.
8 tracks have |pos_last - steps_last| > 10 s (list in end_of_recording_abs_diff_gt_10s_tracks); one stream stops early there.
decision.no_lag_shift_reason: estimated lags are not consistent across tracks (wide, sign-mixed distribution), so shifting would inject noise
decision.recommended_sensitivity: later, optionally train/evaluate under an alternative convention (positions shifted by +/-testStart or +/-2 s), clearly labelled as sensitivity analysis only
decision.recommended_handling: restrict windows to ms>=0 and to the span where both streams exist; consider flagging the 8 tracks with large end-of-recording mismatch
